question: Anil bought some pens at the rate of ₹150 a dozen. He sold them for ₹45 each. His profit percentage is ______%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost price of 12 pens (1 dozen) = ₹150

Selling price of 12 pens = 12 × 45 = ₹540

Total profit = 540 − 150 = ₹390

Profit % = (390 ÷ 150) × 100 = 260%

**∴ The correct answer is 260%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost price of 12 pens = ₹150

Selling price of 1 pen = ₹45

**Formula Used:**

Profit = Selling Price (SP) − Cost Price (CP)

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100
